{{Quote|We're attacking Mrisst?|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The '''Second Battle of Mrisst''' took place during the [[Thrawn campaign]]. The attack of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mrisst/Legends|Mrisst]] was a diversion to distract the [[Coruscant Sector Fleet]] away from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] launched the [[Siege of Coruscant]].<ref name="TLC" />
